name: ai-assistant
description: AI Assistant monorepo — run all services locally

scripts.infra: docker compose up -d db rabbitmq redis
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix services/auth-service && npm run build --prefix services/knowledge-service && npm run build --prefix services/tool-execution-service && npm run build --prefix services/ai-gateway-service
scripts.start:services: concurrently -k -n auth,knowledge,tools,gateway,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm start --prefix services/auth-service" "npm start --prefix services/knowledge-service" "npm start --prefix services/tool-execution-service" "npm start --prefix services/ai-gateway-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/frontend"
scripts.start: npm run infra && wait-on tcp:localhost:5432 tcp:localhost:5672 -t 120000 && npm run start:services
scripts.dev: npm run build:all && npm run start
